$ jet completions zsh
[exit: 0]
--- stdout ---
#compdef jet
# jet zsh completion (generated by `jet completions zsh`)
# Put on your fpath, or:  jet completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_jet
_jet() {
    local -a subcommands
    subcommands=(
        'check:look for problems, build nothing'
        'build:compile to a native binary in ./build/'
        'run:build, then run (or run a project)'
        'test:compile and run top-level test blocks'
        'new:create a new project folder'
        'dev:enter the project shell (jetpack enter)'
        'fmt:rewrite a file to canonical style'
        'fix:preview auto-fixable diagnostics (use --write to apply)'
        'bind:generate a C binding cache from a header'
        'lsp:language server (stdio JSON-RPC)'
        'explain:print the offline essay for a diagnostic code'
        'doctor:diagnose your environment (rustc, cache, PATH, FFI)'
        'completions:print a shell completion script (bash|zsh|fish)'
        'man:print the manual page (roff)'
        'version:print the compiler version'
        'help:print the help text'
        'upgrade:how to download a newer release'
        'add:add a dependency and fetch it'
        'remove:remove a dependency'
        'fetch:download and link all dependencies'
        'update:refresh @latest / branch selectors'
        'store:inspect the content-addressed store'
        'gc:remove unreferenced store entries'
        'install:(redirected) use `jet fetch` instead'
    )
    local -a globalflags
    globalflags=(
        '--color[when to colorize\: auto|always|never]'
        '--json[emit machine-readable JSON diagnostics]'
        '--version[print the compiler version and exit]'
    )
    local filecmds="check build run test fmt fix bind"
    if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
        _describe -t commands 'jet command' subcommands
        return
    fi
    local sub="${words[2]}"
    if [[ " $filecmds " == *" $sub "* ]]; then
        _files
        return
    fi
    _describe -t flags 'flag' globalflags
}
_jet "$@"
--- stderr ---
